description_en: Queries the list of KVCacheInstance instances
description_zh: 查询 KVCacheInstance 实例列表
name: ListKVCacheStores

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID, such as cn-hangzhou-a
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The instance name filter. Prefix matching is used
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称过滤，前缀匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The list of KvcsId values. Separate multiple IDs with commas. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: KvcsId 列表，多个以逗号分隔，最多 100 个
parameters.name: kvcs_ids

parameters.help_en: The instance status filter. Valid values: Creating, Available, InUse, Stopping, Stopped, and Deleting
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. This parameter takes precedence over NextToken if both are specified
parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认 1（与 NextToken 二选一，优先使用 PageNumber）
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. This parameter is used together with PageNumber
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量，默认 10，最大 100（与 PageNumber 配合使用）
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response. This parameter is mutually exclusive with PageNumber
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标，首次查询不传，后续使用上次返回的 NextToken（与 PageNumber 二选一）
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page for cursor-based pagination. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. This parameter is used together with NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 游标分页每页数量，默认 10，最大 100（与 NextToken 配合使用）
parameters.name: max_results
